title: Toeplitz Matrix
summary: Determine if an m x n matrix is Toeplitz by checking if each diagonal from the top-left to the bottom-right contains identical elements.
statement: Determine if an m x n matrix is Toeplitz by checking if each diagonal from the top-left to the bottom-right contains identical elements.
constraints: Every top-left to bottom-right diagonal must contain one repeated value.
reference_solution:
def is_toeplitz_matrix(matrix):
    return all(matrix[row][column]==matrix[row-1][column-1] for row in range(1,len(matrix)) for column in range(1,len(matrix[0])))
hints: Every non-first-row, non-first-column cell has exactly one diagonal predecessor.
Compare each such cell with its upper-left neighbor.
Local equality chains transitively force every entire diagonal to share one value.
editorial: Local equality chains transitively force every entire diagonal to share one value.

tests.explanation: Each cell matches the one diagonally above-left.
The bottom-right two differs from the top-left one.
